title: Interpolation by point indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be any function, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The sum over all $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$ of $f(a)$ times the point indicator of $a$ evaluated at $x$ equals $f(x)$.
